title: Open IO
tagline: Indistinguishabiity Obfuscation Coprocessor and IDE for all your privacy needs
description:
Indistinguishibility Obfuscation is the final frontier of cryptography. Not only do we solve the MPC ceremony problem for FHE, we enable encryption of entire programs. Using PSE's Machina-io repository, we deliver what was a paper yesterday into a usable product. 

Let's face it, FHE is legacy tech.
